name: Threads
role: Primary. Where it is popping off. Text-first, conversational, fast replies win. Three posts a day, every day.
format: Text up to 500 chars, 1-10 images, or video under 5 min. Lead with a line that stands alone. Post the image, say one true thing, ask one question.
rules: Reply to every comment within the first 30 minutes. That window decides reach.
One idea per post. Save the rest for the next slot.
Every finished painting gets a for-sale post here within 3 days of the reveal.
Repost your own best post from 30+ days ago once a week with a new first line.

name: Instagram
role: The portfolio and the storefront window. Collectors check it before they buy. Feed is curated, Stories are raw.
format: Feed 4:5 (1080x1350). Reels 9:16 up to 90s, hook in the first second, captions on. Stories daily, 15s each, raw is fine.
rules: Feed grid: finished work, for-sale posts, the strongest process shots.
Stories: WIP, reference, studio, packing orders, polls, link stickers to the shop.
Pin the current drop or print listing to the top of the grid.

name: TikTok
role: Discovery engine. Painting videos and talking-to-camera. Pure reach, no followers needed.
format: 9:16 vertical, 15-60s. First frame is the most interesting moment, not a logo. Voiceover or on-screen text with what you were thinking.
rules: Same file goes to Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook Reels. Record once, post four times.
Big brush moments, the pull-back reveal, and your face explaining one thing.

name: Facebook
role: Older collectors with money live here. Cross-post the Instagram feed and the videos. Low effort, real sales.
format: Same image or video as Instagram. Longer captions are fine here, people read. Always put the price and how to buy in the post.
rules: Cross-post every reveal, every for-sale post, every drop.
Share to relevant art groups when it is a finished piece, not WIP.

name: YouTube
role: Shorts from the same video files, plus one talking-to-camera video a week. The place the superfans end up.
format: Shorts 9:16 under 60s, same as TikTok. Talking videos 2-6 min, 16:9 or 9:16, phone at eye level, window light, title says what you talk about.
rules: Every Short links to the talking video in the comment.
Title with words people search: 'oil painting', 'how I', 'studio vlog'.

name: Substack
role: The only audience you own. Newsletter every week, drops announced here first, 24 hours before the socials.
format: Under 300 words. Two or three images. One story. One link to what is for sale. Subject line under 6 words.
rules: Every drop: Substack first, socials the next day.
Every post that performs on Threads: mention the newsletter exists.

name: Studio ops
role: Not a platform. The behind-the-scenes tasks that unlock the posts: photographing finished work, listing it, filming, planning.
rules: Every finished piece photographed within 3 days of finishing. One good photo feeds ten posts.
Every finished piece listed or marked sold within a week.

name: Pinterest
role: Off for now. Turn on later for evergreen search traffic to prints.
format: 2:3 vertical, searchable titles, every pin links to the shop.
